MATCH (p:Product)

OPTIONAL MATCH (inv:ProductInventory)
WHERE inv.ProductID = p.ProductID
WITH p,
     coalesce(SUM(inv.Quantity), 0) AS CurrentStock

OPTIONAL MATCH (pod2:PurchaseOrderDetail)
WHERE pod2.ProductID = p.ProductID
  AND pod2.ReceivedQty < pod2.OrderQty
WITH p,
     CurrentStock,
     coalesce(SUM(pod2.OrderQty - pod2.ReceivedQty), 0) AS PendingOrderQty

WITH p.Name AS Product,
     p.ReorderPoint AS ReorderPoint,
     CurrentStock,
     PendingOrderQty,
     CASE
         WHEN CurrentStock < p.ReorderPoint AND PendingOrderQty = 0
             THEN 'Immediate Restock Needed'
         WHEN CurrentStock < p.ReorderPoint
             THEN 'Low Stock - Order Pending'
         ELSE 'Stock OK'
     END AS StockStatus

WHERE StockStatus <> 'Stock OK'

RETURN Product AS Product,
       ReorderPoint AS ReorderPoint,
       CurrentStock AS CurrentStock,
       PendingOrderQty AS PendingOrderQty,
       StockStatus AS StockStatus
ORDER BY CurrentStock ASC
